column1: 1) Do not do all cardio and all bodyweight exercises every day. Follow the day-specific plan above; this prevents excessive fatigue.
2) Progress strength: when all sets reach the top of the rep range with clean form, increase load by the smallest available increment.
3) If form breaks, reduce weight/reps. Keep 1–3 reps in reserve; avoid failure on compound lifts.
4) If knees/joints hurt, replace jumping jacks/high knees/skipping with low-impact marching or cycling. Stop for sharp pain, dizziness, chest pain or unusual breathlessness.
5) Sweat amount is not a measure of fat loss. Train hard enough to feel warm and challenged, but recover well. Hydrate; do not use sweat suits or dehydration tactics.
6) Your 82 kg goal in 90 days is ambitious. Aim for steady loss around 0.4–0.8 kg/week; muscle retention and waist reduction matter more than forcing the scale.
7) At 8–10 PM gym timing, have a light pre-workout snack 60–90 min before; eat a balanced post-workout dinner. Avoid caffeine late if it affects sleep.
8) This is a template. If you have a trainer, pain, or a medical concern, adjust with qualified guidance. Warm up before lifting.
